| [`idlharness.any.js`](https://wpt.fyi/results/animation-worklet/idlharness.any.js) | Fail | 25 / 33 | TEST BUG | the object of the test, `new WorkletAnimation("name")`, throws a TypeError: no animator named `name` is registered in the animation worklet ("If documentAnimatorDefinitions[animatorName] does not exists, throw an TypeError"), and the worker variant evaluates it in a worker, where `WorkletAnimation` (`[Exposed=Window]`) is not defined; `CSS.animationWorklet` is only exposed in the secure contexts, as the `Worklet` interface it returns, and the test is not served over HTTPS (see css/css-paint-api/idlharness.html); these subtests fail in every browser |
| [`inactive-timeline.https.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/animation-worklet/inactive-timeline.https.html) | Fail | 0 / 1 | TEST BUG | the test uses the `scrollSource` option and attribute of `ScrollTimeline`, of an old draft of Scroll-driven Animations (now `source`; the times are now progress-based instead of the times of a `timeRange`): `animation.timeline.scrollSource` is undefined and the test throws; fails in every browser |
| [`multiple-effects-on-same-target-driven-by-individual-local-time.https.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/animation-worklet/multiple-effects-on-same-target-driven-by-individual-local-time.https.html) | Pass | 1 / 1 |  |  |
| [`playback-rate.https.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/animation-worklet/playback-rate.https.html) | Timeout | 5 / 12 | TEST BUG | the scroll-linked subtests use the `scrollSource` option and attribute of `ScrollTimeline`, of an old draft of Scroll-driven Animations (now `source`): `animation.timeline.scrollSource` is undefined and they throw (the last one waits for a local time in milliseconds that a progress-based timeline never gives: it times out); they fail in every browser; `The playback rate set before the animation started playing...` expects the current time to progress from the timeline time of the `play()` call: the animation starts when its pending play task runs, at the next frame (https://drafts.csswg.org/web-animations-1/#playing-an-animation-section), so the current time is one frame (16.7 ms × the playback rate) behind; the Chromium implementation of the time of the test set the start time in `play()` |
| [`scroll-timeline-writing-modes.https.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/animation-worklet/scroll-timeline-writing-modes.https.html) | Fail | 0 / 5 | TEST BUG | the test creates its timeline with `new ScrollTimeline({ scrollSource, orientation })`, the options of an old draft of Scroll-driven Animations (now `source` and `axis`, with progress-based times instead of the times of a `timeRange`): the unknown members are ignored, so the timeline is the scroll timeline of the scrolling element of the document, which does not scroll (its progress stays 0%, so the transform is the one of the first keyframe); fails in every browser |
| [`stateful-animator.https.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/animation-worklet/stateful-animator.https.html) | Pass | 6 / 6 |  |  |
| [`worklet-animation-animator-name.https.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/animation-worklet/worklet-animation-animator-name.https.html) | Fail | 0 / 1 | TEST BUG | the test has no encoding declaration and one of its animator names is Persian: decoded as windows-1252 (UTF-8 is not detected for a document of the network, as in the browsers: `encoding-detection/utf-8.html`), the name contains code points that are not identifier code points (U+00AF, U+00B2…), so `registerAnimator()` throws a TypeError ("If name is not a valid <ident>") and the module does not register the animators |
| [`worklet-animation-creation.https.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/animation-worklet/worklet-animation-creation.https.html) | Fail | 6 / 8 | TEST BUG | `new WorkletAnimation('test-animator', [])` is expected to throw a NotSupportedError: the draft creates a WorkletGroupEffect without children (https://drafts.css-houdini.org/css-animation-worklet-1/#dom-workletanimation-workletanimation); `new WorkletAnimation('unregistered-animator', effect)` is expected to throw an InvalidStateError DOMException: the draft, which is followed, throws a TypeError ("If documentAnimatorDefinitions[animatorName] does not exists, throw an TypeError"); both are behaviors of the former Chromium implementation; they fail in every browser |
| [`worklet-animation-duration.https.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/animation-worklet/worklet-animation-duration.https.html) | Pass | 1 / 1 |  |  |
| [`worklet-animation-get-computed-timing-progress-on-worklet-thread.https.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/animation-worklet/worklet-animation-get-computed-timing-progress-on-worklet-thread.https.html) | Pass | 1 / 1 |  |  |
| [`worklet-animation-local-time-null-1.https.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/animation-worklet/worklet-animation-local-time-null-1.https.html) | Timeout | 2 / 4 | TEST BUG | the last two subtests wait for `animation.currentTime > 1000` on an animation whose effect ends at 1000 ms: a worklet animation is an animation, which is finished and whose current time is limited to the end of its effect (https://drafts.csswg.org/web-animations-1/#update-an-animations-finished-state), so the animator never gets a current time over 1000 and the subtest times out; the worklet animations of the former Chromium implementation never finished |
